steps.together: Most music mixes both: some notes connected under slurs, others short with dots. Read ahead to see which is which.
steps.mix: Smooth, then short, then smooth again.
steps.canCan: “Can-Can” by Offenbach: the short, bouncing quarter notes against the smooth runs of eighth notes. Lean on the long first note: its accent says so.
steps.canCanInTime: Now in time, a little slower than the real dance.
